verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a workspace-admin switch that disables personal data storage so Parahelp does not retain it. That is a data-retention control, not an opt-out of product telemetry or usage tracking, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit. Nothing in the pack documents disabling telemetry, analytics or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
